surface_value: It is hypothesised that the pain is caused by compression of the trigeminal nerve at its entry into the pons, and that this leads to demyelination - the loss of the myelin sheath (Jensen et al, 2003). In turn, demyelination results in the transmission of abnormal pain messages so that the patient experiences neuropathic pain.
